item.title: Comment on India has Too Few Tourists by SDW
item.description:
India is fascinating. I've been twice, once in 2006 for a few weeks and once in 2016 for two months. Travelled extensively and would go back for sure, however it's not at all a place I'd consider to be a mainstream tourist destination.

It's exhausting, everybody is trying to screw you out of just a bit more money and while it's still cheap that sort of thing wears on you. People can be extremely off putting, especially with the staring. Related, I would absolutely recommend against women going there alone, or even going out by themselves out of the company of man.

It's also filthy. People have zero compunction about discarding any sort of waste on the ground.

All of that said, the place is really amazing too. Lots of wild sights to see and it's a genuine adventure. The food, of course, is amazing. There is a true vastness to the country and the fact that you can go somewhere to wild and alien and that the dominant language is English is really something special. So yeah, a great place to visit, but not for everyone.
